about.heading: About Buffalo Plumbing PROS
about.bodyHtml:
Welcome to Buffalo Plumbing PROS, your premier residential plumbing service provider serving Buffalo and surrounding communities since 2005. Our licensed and insured technicians are available 24/7 for all your emergency plumbing needs across Downtown, Allentown, and all Buffalo neighborhoods.

From routine maintenance to complex installations, we handle everything including water heater repairs, drain cleaning, leak detection, and complete bathroom remodels. Our upfront pricing and satisfaction guarantee have made us the most trusted plumbing team in Western New York.

Ceiling leaks are not always caused by plumbing issues. In many cases, water intrusion comes from damaged roofing materials or improperly sealed flashing. Before proceeding with pipe repairs, it’s important to inspect the exterior and fix a leaking roof in Madison if the source of the problem is coming from above.

We're proud to maintain an A+ BBB rating and offer special discounts for seniors and military personnel. All work is performed to code and backed by our industry-leading warranty.
